change: Ordinary Direct3D Presents return synchronously when no GPU fence, capture, timing readback, or scene comparison is required; periodic fences and opt-in diagnostics retain ordered asynchronous completion.
scope: Generic Direct3D 8/9 Present scheduling. The diagnostic renderer also flushes shared geometry and texture references before guest resource mutation or release.

comparisonToPreviousExactRevision.conclusion: This single exact-revision run does not establish a throughput improvement; its main evidence is that 75% of Presents bypassed Promise scheduling while queue depth remained bounded. Browser and system scheduling produced material run-to-run variance.

sourceReports.purpose: combined GPU timing, scene equivalence, and frame-capture startup trial

validation: visual inspection of the rendered Humus scene
limitations: Present submission timing is not display scan-out.
The optimization removes scheduling work, but this run does not demonstrate a statistically stable FPS or frame-time improvement.
This run verifies the original Humus executable; broader compatibility still requires additional DirectX 8/9 programs.
